description: This PHP file defines the 'Featured' controller for the OpenCart admin module extension. It manages CRUD operations and rendering for the 'Featured' module, including loading language, handling requests for editing, saving, adding, and deleting module configurations, and rendering the module's view.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Featured' module in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Featured module, loading necessary data and template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module settings via AJAX, including validation and database update.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Featured module with default or localized name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module instance based on module_id.
